body.message:
So my final dates for booking: from June 17 until July 24 which equals to 37 days * 255 = 9,435 AED.
It will bi given by cash to you from Ms GHAZAL.
The apartment should have a 2 toilets and the nearest one to the swimming pool with good condition (brand new and cleanness overall).

I will be waiting the confirmation once you receive the money with an official receipt copy to be send to me here and by email.

Also what about the deposit payment ? As i did not receive any info where to deposit it then you send me a confirmation.

Finally once all done, please share with me the number of guest relations in Al-Zorah Sea-Side Hills residences so i can finalize many requests with them.

Please do not forget to answer me or if i can get a clear answer later from guest relations about my question above: is it two sets of bed sheets and towels or only one so i can prepare myself for my long stay.

N.B: please share with me the options available at Dubai so i can book on time my next stay from july 24 until august 31 or i will inform you earlier to stay in Ajman.

Thanks in advance
